`/work/4302` shows "Delivered" only because `receipt_ids` is non-empty and no review controls (empty `verdicts`); `/work/4301` shows no "Delivered" or "Published" text — verify: e2e; unit test on the status mapper.
No delivery date or time is drawn on any step, and the Tola card, "TEST TEMPLATE" tag and "Ask Tola" are absent — verify: e2e DOM assertions; grep copy.

Approve sends `POST /work/4301/change` with `{action:"document_review", expected_revision, case_revision, change_version_id, version_id: <documents[].id>, verdict:"approve", note}`; with an empty note the button stays off and no request is sent; Return and Reject open a confirm step and cancelling sends nothing — verify: unit on `changeBodies.ts`; e2e checks the request body in the mock log.
A verdict not in the row's `verdicts[]` has no button; `4309`, `4311` and any read with empty `verdicts` show no write control and no banner — verify: e2e.

`/work/4304` execution form: nothing preselected for `kind` or `evidence`; the evidence list holds exactly the read's `evidence[]`; submitting sends `{action:"execution", ..., kind, evidence, note, scope_items, dossier_id:null, candidate_id:null}` with blank `scope_items` as `null` — verify: unit; e2e body assertion.
`/work/4305` (empty `evidence[]`) disables "Record evidence" with "No proof file is recorded for this case yet" and sends nothing — verify: e2e.
The execution form is absent when `stage !== "execution"` — verify: e2e on `4301` and `4306`.

`/work/4308` close form: nothing preselected for mode, receipt or either signature; `receipt_id` options equal the union of `documents[].receipt_ids`; both signature lists equal `evidence[]`; no evidence id can be typed — verify: e2e; unit.

Mode `signed` requires both signature objects with all six fields filled and `signed_at` as an ISO 8601 string with offset; any empty field keeps "Close the change" disabled; the body has `client_signature_id` and `client_signature` non-null — verify: unit table over each missing field; e2e body assertion.

Mode `owner_applicability` hides the client signature section, sends `client_signature_id:null` and `client_signature:null`, and requires the confirm step "This closes the change without a client signature." — verify: e2e; unit.

`close` sends `operation_key` as a uuid; after a network drop the "Check again" path re-reads and does not resend; an explicit retry of the same attempt reuses the key and a new attempt makes a new one; a double click sends one request — verify: unit with fake fetch counting calls and keys.

`/work/4309` (`can_close:false`) and `/work/4310` (`closure_id` set) show no close form; `4310` shows "Closed", the mode text only if the page itself just sent it (a reload shows "Closed" and `closure_id` only), and no person name, date or "verified" text — verify: e2e.

A failed job `4303` shows "Retry" (`can_retry:true`) and "Cancel"; `4301` shows no Retry; each sends `{action:"operate_delivery", ..., job_id, operation, reason}` with a required reason and a confirm step — verify: e2e; unit.
`restart` is drawn only when `can_restart` is true (`4310`), asks for a reason (1 to 2000), confirms, and sends `{action:"restart", ..., reason}` once — verify: e2e on `4310` and `4311`.
Every write body has `expected_revision`, `case_revision` and `change_version_id` equal to the last read; after a 201 the next write uses freshly read values — verify: unit sequence.

A 409 on any action keeps typed text, shows "This change was updated by someone else. Reload to see it.", and sends nothing automatically; a 422 with `fields[]` shows each message by its field; a 403 `csrf_failed` says "Press save again" without resending; 413, 415, 429 and 503 show F-85's wording; a network drop or 5xx shows "We could not confirm this was saved" with "Check again" only — verify: mock scenarios; fetch counts in unit tests.
A failed re-read after a 201 leaves the form locked with "Couldn't refresh" and Try again, never a repeat of the write — verify: unit.
`/work/4312` and a live work id the caller cannot see both show exactly "This record is unavailable." — verify: open both.
`deployment_authorized` is false in every state and no copy says deployment is authorised or the change notice/note "was sent" unless a receipt supports it — verify: unit on the mapper; grep copy.

Nothing in the page names a signer or approver the read does not carry, and the "Milestone 3's scope now includes" line and "Open milestones" link are absent — verify: e2e DOM absent; no empty gap in screenshots.

No write is made by page load, polling or navigation; POSTs to `/work/{id}/change` come only from a press — verify: e2e asserts zero POSTs on load; `grep -rn "liveApi.POST" frontend/src/features/change-request` shows them only in the command send path.

Layout at 1440 and 390 matches the 8 boards for the parts kept (stage track, document rows, forms, closed state), with a vertical track on mobile as in the mobile boards, keyboard order and focus working on forms and confirm steps — verify: screenshots at both widths against the 8 boards; Tab through each form.

Against live Django 8030 (Postgres), for a `pmo-change/v1` item at a notice or go_live stage, the page's document rows, receipts and jobs match `curl` of `GET /work/{id}/change`; one `document_review` on a test change returns 201 and the re-read shows it; any action that cannot be exercised live is stated in build.md rather than claimed — verify: compare page and curl; record the response.

New unit tests cover the five body builders, the stage and document status mappers, the close validation table, null handling and the error mapper; `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: High. `close` records PM and client signatures, including `owner_applicability`, which waives the client signature. `restart`, `retry` and `cancel` change a change request's life and are hard to undo. They are revision-gated and role-gated by the read (`can_close`, `can_restart`, `jobs[]`). The notice and go-live note documents go to the client (external-messaging) and need reviewing before they are sent, so the screen must not imply anything was sent unless `jobs[]` or a receipt says so. The change also touches auth (role-gated actions) and product-decision (D-7 signature rules). It is a new flow, so product acceptance is required. The merge goes to the design engineer's batch.
